title: TimeOmni-1: Incentivizing Complex Reasoning with Time Series in Large Language Models

claim.summary: TimeOmni-1 uses temporal reasoning priors in SFT followed by task-grounded GRPO, supported by TSR-SUITE.

modules.scope_reason: The contribution modifies language-model reasoning through supervised and reinforcement learning.

modules.name: TSR-SUITE reasoning task construction
modules.scope_reason: TSR-SUITE is explicitly constructed to develop temporal reasoning models: hierarchical human-reviewed CoT examples become SFT and RL data. As a single existing data-construction record its primary contribution is training_data, consistent with ChatTS; multiple task labels alone do not make it a reusable runtime module. The test split remains recorded as evaluation evidence.
